capabilities: Insert content blocks (highlight blocks, quotes, code, Markdown tables) from a floating + panel
Create 2-5 column layouts with editable headings, alignment, and draggable widths
Format selected text with colors, links, alignment, indentation, and local comments
Search notes by title, path, or alias and insert native wikilinks
extras: Experimental Home and Magical Cards features are off by default, require companion plugins exposing compatible APIs, and are still in development; the base content blocks work independently. Installation is manual from release files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css), requires Obsidian 1.13.7+, development source is in a private repo, and the author accepts Ko-fi donations.
motivation: The author was a heavy Feishu Docs user who loved its floating + button and built this to recreate editing without learning Markdown syntax in Obsidian.
problem: Editing in Obsidian requires knowing Markdown syntax, and lacks the point-and-click insertion and formatting tools found in office-style editors like Feishu Docs.

requires.name: Companion plugins with compatible APIs (for experimental Home / Magical Cards features)

summary: Editing helper that adds a floating insert panel for content blocks, a selection formatting toolbar, 2-5 column layouts, and note link insertion.
